THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Janaka Bandara Thennakoon, Minister of Lands and LandDevelopment hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 ofthe Land Acquisition Act, that the land described below is needed fora public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions ofthat Act.

An allotment of land called Vellamkulam in total extent of about1.0556 Hectare, depicted in the Advance Tracing No. Tri/KNN/2013/192 dated 27.11.2013 prepared by the Superintendent ofSurveys - Trincomalee District, situated in the Village calledVellamkulam in the Minor Division of Kinniya Pattu in the DivisionalSecretary’s Division of Kinniya in Trincomalee District, EasternProvince and bounded as follows:
01. Lot ‘A’ – Vellamkulam – Extent: 1.0556 HectareNorth: Vellamkulam (Paddy Field); East and South: Vellamkulam(Garden); West: Vellamkulam (Paddy Field).
Janaka Bandara Thennakoon,Minister of Lands and Land Development.
My Ref. No.: 4/3/4/2013/D/312.Divisional Secretary’s Ref. No.: KI/DS/LA/LLRC.Ministry of Lands and Land Development,‘Mihikatha Medura’,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.19th December, 2014.
